items.title: Job Vacancy - Aluminium Fabricator
items.summary: Bann Architectural Systems Ltd are a specialist aluminium window, doors and curtain walling manufacturer.
items.body:
Bann Architectural Systems Ltd are a specialist Aluminium Window, Doors, Curtain Walling facades manufacturers & Installers. Due to continued growth we require a aluminium fabricator to join our team.

The successful applicant will be required to work in factory environment and may on occasions be required to assist other fabricators off site.

Salary - Negotiable

Work Hours - 40 Hours per week

Monday 8am - 4.30pm

Tuesday - Thursday 8am - 5.30pm

Friday 8am - 1.00pm

Duties -

- Responsible for production of high quality aluminium windows, doors & curtain Walling.

- Will be required to manufacture from provided cutting lists, set up machinery, cutting, crimping in order to produce finished product.

- May at times be required to assist with other fabricators off site.

- Maintaining good housekeeping and a safe working environment.

To be considered, it would be preferable but not a necessity to be:

- Experienced in the manufacture of aluminium windows, doors etc.

- Have the ability to read and interpret technical drawings with close attention to detail.

- Work as part of a team, be punctual & reliable

If you require further information call Keith or Kyle on 02892 698855 or click on link below to download application form.

Completed application forms should be returned to Bann Architectural Systems Ltd, 81 Halfway Rd, Banbridge, Co.Down, BT32 4HB or via email to Keith@bann-systems.co.uk

Applicants of interest will be contacted for interviews.

Bann Architectural Systems Ltd is an equal opportunity employer
